basics.name: Peerapob Jermmora
basics.label: Technical Consultant – ServiceNow
basics.summary: ServiceNow Technical Consultant with 4+ years at MFEC delivering enterprise implementations across Strategic Portfolio Management, Customer Service Management, App Engine and IT Asset Management. Works across the whole delivery path, from turning business requirements into solution designs to building workflows, UI Builder workspaces and row-level security, and handing over to clients.

work.name: MFEC Public Company Limited
highlights: Core technical consultant on ServiceNow engagements, owning delivery from requirements and solution design through configuration, development and client handover.
Led the low-code (App Engine) development team on an enterprise self-service platform.
Authored Solution Design Documents and BRD-writing standards (priority and status definitions) that align BA, development and client teams.

work.name: MFEC Public Company Limited
highlights: Developed ServiceNow CSM and App Engine applications and their integrations with surrounding systems for a public-facing service platform.
Built ServiceNow IT Asset Management and a Zendesk-based CRM for enterprise clients.

projects.name: ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) Implementation
highlights: Designed Demand Management workflows, project template automation, and percent-complete / state rollup logic across Demand, Project and Portfolio.
Delivered UI Builder and Workspace customizations, UI Action bundles, and row-level security across four business personas.
Configured multi-currency (THB/USD) financial display and restructured the Solution Design Document.

projects.name: Self-Service Hub Platform
highlights: Led the low-code development team building ServiceNow App Engine applications that let internal staff manage and govern the licenses and permits the business operates under.

projects.name: Service Management Platform
highlights: Built ServiceNow CSM and App Engine applications through which members of the public request the client's services and financial-institution officers handle them.
Developed integrations between the platform and the client's internal systems.

projects.name: IT Asset Management (ITAM)
highlights: Developed ServiceNow ITAM to record and manage the IT asset lifecycle and support IT asset service requests.

projects.name: Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
highlights: Built a Zendesk and Sunshine CRM integrated with the call center and back-office systems, letting end users report issues, file claims, track repairs and enquire about projects.
